ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white central region occupies approximately 85% of visible surface area, contrasting sharply with low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels along the peripheral boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged amplitude variations observed on the right lobe compared to the more uniform peaks on the left lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced black pigmentation 'caps' on the distal tips that are asymmetrical in surface area between the left and right lobes.
